Q: How to configure VS code for pytest with environment variable A:

Could not really figure out how to fix "unit" test debugging with Vscode. But with Pytest one can call tests from the command line like this:
python -m pytest <test file>

That means the VSCode launch.json debug configuration file can be setup using the "module" property for Python:

"configurations": [
        {
            "name": "Python: Module",
            "type": "python",
            "request": "launch",
            "module": "pytest",
            "args": ["--headful","--capture=no", "--html=report.html"],
        }

This is good enough to do debugging of python tests. Also you can then insert environment variables

   "env": {
        "ENV_VAR":"RandomStuff"
    }

Q: Retrieve >901 rows from SQL Server 2008 linked server to Active Directory A:

I need to change the MaxTempTableSize setting in Active Directory. To do that you need to use Ntdsutil.exe which you can type on the run command then follow these steps

At the Ntdsutil.exe command prompt, type LDAP policies, and then press ENTER.
At the LDAP policy command prompt, type Set MaxTempTableSize to 2000. -> Or any number you want
To view the changes, type Show Values
To save the changes, typeCommit Changes
To quit, type q

Q: How to change a variable from a bunch of potential variables A:

Better to use None rather than an empty string "" for an unset variable. That way you won't block an empty input string (there's no need to make it a special case). Also, if the variables are numbered consecutively, then a list representation might make more sense than a dict.

Q: Unable to Install Visual Studio Code Extensions A:

Not really answer, but when I had extension installation problem VSCode DevTools helped me to see actual network requests. You can check Network tab in VS Code DevTools for verify extension installation request-response. Press CTRL+SHIFT+P and type Toggle Developer Tools
